periodization.definition: Planned variation of training stress over time (e.g. volume, intensity, specificity) to peak for performance.

acwr.definition: Acute:Chronic Workload Ratio — compares recent load to rolling average; used in load management research.

rsi.definition: Reactive Strength Index — jump height divided by ground contact time; used in plyometric monitoring.

cmj.definition: Countermovement Jump — common force-plate test of lower-body neuromuscular function.

diaas.definition: Digestible Indispensable Amino Acid Score — FAO method for protein quality vs human needs.

tef.definition: Thermic Effect of Food — energy used to digest, absorb, and metabolize nutrients.

gi.definition: Glycemic Index — blood glucose response to a carbohydrate food vs reference.

epigenetics.definition: Heritable changes in gene expression without DNA sequence changes (e.g. methylation).

pmid.definition: PubMed ID — unique identifier for citations in the PubMed database.

rct.definition: Randomized Controlled Trial — experimental study design with random assignment.
